acceptanceCriteria: Regex literals after control-condition parentheses cannot generate phantom legacy cases; every real it appears once.
Unsupported or continued assertions, including template-substitution assertions and withContext chains, are extracted or retained as case-bound unknowns.
Supported JavaScript literal escapes decode correctly or remain explicit unknowns; they never silently change expected values.
Precondition fixture order preserves hook/case execution order; a reordered setup cannot receive parity-candidate against the old order.
Nested case setup/visit/intercept calls and noninline or conditional hooks are discovered or cause case-bound uncertainty; no empty/invented precondition set establishes parity-candidate.
Precondition canonical text hashes to its emitted SHA256 even above 240 bytes; visited URLs remain available to crosswalk scoring.
Malformed registries and missing/stale mapping-review or target-assertion evidence refuse or remain unresolved, never reviewed parity candidates.
Keep old command output bytes and BehaviorLegacyCase wire shape unchanged; add adversarial regressions and retain focused tests plus independent review.
body:
Read-only review for beamfall/corvint#811 at HEAD a1a09bbcd04d64a02574d217e49117e9f45973b0, base 645304a2fb71065f9061d8d8d866600d703e84c6. Confirmed by a CLI compiled from this HEAD using go1.27.2. Installed discovery tool: Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 407; Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.407. Review fixture-result SHA256: 71268a3c6383d18433367b0375808ca24cc4660c4b9673c2a0820b9fb7b4c036.

P2 reproductions:
1. behavior_legacy_lex.go:137 returns false for a regex after a control condition. describe('s',()=>{ if (ready) /it('phantom', () => {})/.test(value); it('real',()=>expect(1).toBe(1)); }); emits phantom and real.
2. behavior_legacy_lex.go:167 legacyEscape maps '\x41' to x41 and '\b' to b without unknown.
3. behavior_legacy_discovery.go:733 stops expect chaining at first call: expect(x).withContext('context').toBe(1) emits withContext|x|context and silently drops toBe. expect(x).to.be.a('number').and.equal(1) drops equal(1).
4. behavior_legacy_lex.go:208 discards substitution code: const value = `${expect(x).toBe(1)}`; expect(y).toBe(2); emits only y and no unknown. Standalone Cypress .and assertions are also omitted without unknown.
5. behavior_legacy_discovery.go:560 sorts fixtures: reversing cy.visit('/before');cy.task('seed','A') produces identical lists and parity-candidate against copied old target.
6. behavior_legacy_discovery.go:617 and 625 skip nested known case precommands: cy.then(()=>{cy.task('seed','A');cy.visit('/cart');});expect(1).toBe(1); gives fixtures=[]/unknown=[] and parity-candidate. Noninline beforeEach(seedHelper) at 455-457 also vanishes without case uncertainty.
7. behavior_legacy_discovery.go:466 still adds conditional-hook fixtures after a file-level hook-in-dynamic-scope unknown; if(flag){beforeEach(()=>cy.task('seed','A'));} then a matching case receives parity-candidate with no case unknown.
8. behavior_legacy_discovery.go:637 truncates precondition Text at 240 bytes while SHA256 binds full text: a literal 300-character URL gives SHA256 != Digest(Text) and loses visited-URL matching.
9. behavior_legacy_crosswalk.go:53 accepts {} and minimal schema-zero tests with missing mapping review/annotation. A copied tuple yields parity-candidate; default fixture tests themselves use this missing evidence.

DCP-V1-060..069 witnesses cover small happy-path fixtures but miss the above. Focused internal doccorpus TestLegacy|TestBehavior|TestAFUV1BehaviorProviderV1BytesUnchanged passed (146.423s); CLI Docs|Corpus|Help verification pending at filing. Source model/compiler/encoding unchanged relative to base. Native task created for confirmed bugs, not acceptance or completion.

completion.reason: Fixed by beamfall/corvint#824 (merged 2026-10-12T03:48:04Z): discover-legacy exact chainer allowlist, symlink refusal, shared crosswalk namespace; Codex round 11 PASS; DCP-V1-060..069 accepted; evidence is the sha256 of docs/build-log/2026-10-11-docs-corpus-discover-legacy.md at origin/main.

title: GH #811 review: legacy discovery silently loses assertions/preconditions and admits unsupported parity candidates
